plays.title: Post AI coding wins from your VPS setup
plays.description: Share narrative posts about using Claude Code to build iOS apps and features by running it on your server which then uses SSH and cloud Macs to compile.
plays.action:
1. Build something meaningful with Claude Code on your VPS (e.g. an iOS Swift app or new API).
2. Ask it to take a screenshot or generate a preview link.
3. Tweet the story exactly like: '🤯 And it worked! It made a basic iOS app in full Swift then made a screenshot and sent me a link to check it!'
4. Add details: built on Hetzner VPS, SSH to MacinCloud, Xcode. End with why this setup is great.

plays.title: Demo fun experiments on your personal site
plays.description: Add and immediately tweet about quirky interactive features on your own domain, such as emulated OS environments with drag and drop file support.
plays.action:
1. Create or enhance a fun page on your personal site (e.g. Windows 3.11 emulator).
2. Implement real interactions like dragging files from desktop into the emulator's C:\DOCS or C:\SHARED folders using WebFS.
3. Tweet: 'Another little thing that nothing but Fable could have helped me make today: You can now drag and drop files from your own computer into Windows 3.11 on [link]'
4. Explain the folders and why it's cool (shared library feel).

plays.title: Share your phone + VPS development lifestyle
plays.description: Talk about coding and monitoring projects from your iPhone using SSH, and renting cloud Macs for specific builds instead of local machines.
plays.action:
1. Set up Termius (or similar) to SSH into your VPS from iPhone.
2. Do real work this way and track an AI coding session.
3. Tweet the origin story: 'So @marckohlbrugge told me to finally make a Nomads iOS app today But I didn't want to do it locally... now it's coding an iOS app via SSH with Xcode on a Mac Mini somewhere in California!'
4. Close with: 'My work now is about 50-50 on my iPhone or MacBook Pro, both via Termius SSH to VPS! It's lovely!'

plays.title: Share honest infrastructure limits
plays.description: Post about everyday operational issues like hitting quotas on services that power your multiple sites to show authenticity.
plays.action:
1. Note when a key service (email, API, hosting) quota or limit affects your projects.
2. Post immediately and plainly: 'Hit my @Cloudflare Email Sending quota today 😭 Can't send any emails on any of my sites anymore'
3. Keep it short and real. Follow up in replies if you find a fix.

hooks: Hit my @Cloudflare Email Sending quota today 😭
Another little thing that nothing but Fable could have helped me make today:
So @marckohlbrugge told me to finally make a Nomads iOS app today
I didn't touch anything, I just prompt, and I also can't even login to check on it because it runs headless on the Mac Mini in the cloud!
angles: Building production iOS apps entirely by prompting Claude Code running on a VPS that SSHs into remote Mac Minis
Adding delightful interactions like drag-and-drop file sharing to retro emulators on personal websites using WebFS
Conducting 50/50 development work from an iPhone via SSH clients like Termius to avoid carrying a laptop
Publicly documenting both exciting 'it worked' AI builds and painful real limits like Cloudflare email quotas
